Pictures and clips in a setting\'s explanation

Some settings show a picture, a short clip, or the setting off and on side by side when you press their question mark. A question mark that has one is drawn in colour. The pictures are not part of the app: they are downloaded from the project\'s data repository, with one set for the light look and one for the dark look. All at once downloads the set for the look you use. One at a time downloads a picture when you open its explanation. Off shows the words only. This setting is Ask by default.
Asks the next time you open an explanation that has a picture
One download for the look you use, then no waiting
Each picture downloads when you open its explanation
This deletes every help picture on the phone. They download again when you ask for them.
